title: The Midnight Ledger
shortDescription: An empty crate, an honest clock, and an expertly dishonest signature.
description: An auction lot disappears in a locked transit cage. The porter has left his mark on the crate and the assessor has signed an alibi. Follow weights, access, and time through seven rooms to defend a person on evidence rather than sympathy. An original fair-play historical detective adventure with recoverable mistakes.
author: Studio Null
